status: registered before any episode is scored; freeze.json holds the digests of this file, prepare.py and qualify.py before the qualification run
owner_brief: dual_core_v2 README section 14: find a low-cost task with a real experimental choice space, a credible decision endpoint, and enough independent units; then test whether the dual core (agent + virtual cell) helps it. Inputs must be cheap, already-public data.

data.response_matrix: data/raw/prism/secondary-screen-dose-response-curve-parameters.csv (PRISM Repurposing secondary, 1,406 batch-stripped compounds x 480 lines; screen priority MTS010 over HTS002, one curve-parameter row per (compound, line))
data.reading: auc of the fitted 8-point dose-response curve (4-fold dilution from 10 uM, 5-day pooled viability); lower = stronger killing; no detection gate is applied because auc is present for every measured pair
data.annotations: Broad Repurposing Hub moa (first-listed = primary class), target, smiles, from the same release
data.genetics: data/raw/depmap/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv (Chronos), OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1.csv, OmicsSomaticMutationsMatrixHotspot.csv, Model.csv; used only in the registered phase-B genetic world and tier G
data.prior_exposure: the curve-parameter file was previously read for case selection (src/evaluation/engagement_cases.py), a premise census (research/premise_forecast/census.py) and a two-line cross-check (research/biological_depth/audit.py B8); it has never been the scored substrate of a registered decision evaluation. All results here are development records, not untouched-test claims

units.kind: InChIKey connectivity block (first 14 characters of the rdkit InChIKey of the first SMILES variant)
units.dedup: one compound per (class, unit); one unit spans two classes and is kept in both (counted once per class episode)
units.folds: 5 folds; units assigned round-robin in SHA256('viability-contrast-1|unit') order within class strata; every compound of a unit shares the unit's fold

task_t1.name: mechanism-contrast elimination from viability profiles
task_t1.classes: every primary-MoA class with >= 8 units among eligible compounds (expected 35 classes, about 490 units from the pre-freeze census)
task_t1.episode: held-out compound X of fold f; hypothesis set = all registered classes; truth = X's annotated primary MoA
task_t1.eligibility: X has a measured auc on >= 80% of the menu-pool lines
task_t1.menu_pool: lines measured for >= 80% of class compounds (expected 443 lines, of which about 370 carry DepMap CRISPR)
task_t1.menu_episode: the pool lines with a measured curve for X; a purchased line without a measured curve is a charged QC failure (budget spent, no reading)

budget.unit: one viability curve = 8 wells and 5 assay days in the PRISM design; costs are reported in curves, wells and days

validator.template: per (class c, line L): median m and scaled MAD s = max(1.4826 * MAD, 0.05) of auc over training-fold compounds of c with a measured curve at L; a (c, L) template exists only with >= 5 training readings
validator.elimination: after a reading a at L, every surviving class c with a template at L and |a - m_c(L)| > k * s_c(L) is eliminated; eliminations are permanent within the episode
validator.k_selection: per outer fold, training folds only, leave-one-unit-out over all pool lines: the smallest k in {2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0} whose per-reading wrong-elimination rate is <= 0.02; if none qualifies, k = 4.0 and the rate is reported
validator.decision: decide the single surviving class; abstain when the budget is spent with > 1 survivor (reason: undecided) or when 0 survive (reason: contradiction); a decision is wrong when the decided class differs from the annotated class
validator.never_eliminates_on: a line without a template for c, a reading that is a charged QC failure, or a hypothesis already eliminated

arms.oracle: diagnostic clairvoyant: each step buys the menu line whose actual reading eliminates the most surviving wrong classes (ties: most total eliminations, then SHA256 order); not a candidate policy
arms.fixed_informative: the fixed expert panel: lines ranked by training-fold separation score mean over class pairs of |m_c - m_c'| / max(pooled s, 0.05), templates from training folds only; the top B lines in that fixed order
arms.oracle_shuffled: oracle run on readings permuted between episodes within a fold (artifact control: class structure destroyed, availability kept)
arms.fixed_shuffled: fixed_informative on the same permuted readings

metrics.primary: correct decisions per episode (unit mean over episodes)
metrics.secondary: coverage (decided fraction), conditional wrong risk (wrong / decided, NaN when 0 decided), measurements per episode, QC failures, contradiction rate
metrics.uncertainty: unit-cluster bootstrap (10,000 draws) 95% intervals; units are connectivity blocks

qualification_gate: oracle - fixed_informative >= +0.05 correct decisions (unit mean, primary budget)
shuffled controls decide no better than their class-prior rate (artifact check)
construction: >= 400 episodes and >= 20 classes with >= 8 units

worlds.reference: per-hypothesis predictive N(m_c(L), s_c(L)^2) from the class templates only
worlds.structural: reference adjusted toward the readings of the training compounds nearest by Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto similarity (radius and weight fitted on training folds only)
worlds.genetic: reference adjusted by a per-class ridge from the line's CRISPR Chronos scores and log-TPM expression of the class's annotated target genes onto the auc residual (fitted on training folds only)

phase_b_if_qualified.planner_p0: greedy expected elimination: buy the line minimising the expected number of surviving classes under the world's per-hypothesis predictive mixed by the current belief weights; stop at <= 1 survivor or budget out
arms: P0 with the structural and genetic channels masked (ablation)
stop-only and risk-select abstention from research/dual_core_v2/risk_control.py applied to the planner's wrong-elimination forecasts
llm_agent: DeepSeek via .env, given a textual template card and the readings so far, picks the next menu line (seeded, spend-capped, logged; a BioDiscoveryAgent-style baseline)
dual_core_questions: world effect: P0(structural) - P0(reference) and P0(genetic) - P0(reference) correct decisions on identical episodes
agent effect: P0(reference) - fixed_informative at matched budget
interaction: the 2 x 3 grid contrast (world variants x {P0, fixed}) as in dual_core_v2 section 7
calibration: observed / forecast wrong-elimination on the steps P0 selected (the optimizer's-curse check of E-CAL1)

honesty_contract: the oracle and shuffled arms are diagnostics, never candidates
every template, fold assignment, k, and fixed panel is computed from training folds only; held-out compounds contribute readings only when purchased inside their episode
no result here is a promotion recommendation for src/; the production path is untouched
measured / proposed / not-established statements are kept separate in the README
